pass.description: null is the checker's documented can't-tell state (genuinely unable to determine pass/fail) -- distinct from omitting the field, and rejected by check-verdict.py rather than treated as a guessed value.

checked.description: At least one thing actually investigated, required even on a clean pass with an empty findings[] — closes the vacuous-accept case where pass:true/findings:[] is schema-valid but shows no verification work. Found by mh:deep-audit 2026-09-19: a checker primed with 3 known-suspect items addressed 0 of them, indistinguishable from never having looked. Mirrors mh:idea-audit's identical checked[] guard.
